about:
Zonmedical, based in Newark, Delaware, manufactures a broad range of hospital equipment. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces surgical and ICU equipment, medical imaging systems, neonatal intensive care devices, medical consumables, diagnostics, disposables, ultrasound and printing systems. Specific products include emergency trolleys (models KTR-A100, KTR-A101) and treatment trolleys (KTR-A200, KTR-A201). Manufacturing processes include compression molding. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not specified.

Zonmedical serves healthcare providers, hospitals, and medical facilities requiring surgical, critical care, imaging, and neonatal equipment. Its product categories span consumables, diagnostics, disposables, ultrasound, and printing systems for clinical environments.

The company emphasizes adherence to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016 quality management standards, as well as ISO 14971 for medical device risk management. It highlights comprehensive customer service training for each equipment piece and a commitment to innovative services and solutions.
